notes: The 12 use cases of Shin_MassBank_Annotation_Metadata_Proposal_EN_V2.docx section 6, with the notation string as written in each source document. Divergences between the sources are deliberately NOT reconciled: they are the fixtures that document the disagreement. 'parseable' is a statement about the notation GRAMMAR only. 'resolvable_under' lists the vocabulary versions under which every token resolves with status accepted (strict mode); an empty list on a grammatically valid string means the string mixes tag generations, which is the observable consequence of ISSUE-SECTIONS-5-8-STALE.
